## Results submission

- [ ] The pull request adds exactly one run directory, `results/<id>/`, made by `buffon run` and not edited afterwards (it is sealed by `MANIFEST.sha256`).
- [ ] `python3 -m buffon verify results/<id> --submission` accepts it on my machine.
- [ ] `submission.toml` says who ran it, what the machine was (and what else could run on it), and whether I maintain or work on any arm in the run.
- [ ] No gate was switched off (`--allow-noisy`, `--allow-short`, `--no-calibrate`, `--no-quiet-gate`, `--allow-frequency-scaling`, `--no-telemetry`, `--aa` other than `all`).
- [ ] If this reproduces an earlier run, `reproduces` names its id and the output of `buffon compare` is in the directory.

The index is regenerated by `python3 -m buffon index results`; do not edit it by hand.
